notes: Each case is {name, head, request, expect} or {name, create, expect}. expect is {commit}, {head} (create) or {reject: code}.
request = the Rust OpRequest fields (actor, idempotency_key, op tagged by kind, now, new_message_id, target, reply_target, thread_target, last_message) plus actor_addresses (cloud only).

message.send: thread_root must name a message of this conversation (request.thread_target) that has no thread_root itself, else invalid_thread_root (checked after reply_to). A committed send sets read_cursors[actor] = new seq when read_cursors[actor] (absent = 0) >= the head's last_seq before the send, else leaves it; the change stays kind message. A null thread_root is absent.

A runner calls apply(head, request). REQUIRED for the Rust owner: every head carries agent_text_streak (0 at create) and last_agent_text_at; a text send by an agent adds 1 to the streak of the thread the message joins (agent_text_streak for the top level, thread_agent_streaks[root id] for a thread; a thread entry at 0 is dropped and an empty map is absent) and sets last_agent_text_at, a human text resets the streak of its own thread only, a person's question.answer resets the question's thread, a text-less work card changes neither; an agent text is refused with agent_budget when its thread's streak >= 6 and agent_rate within 2000 ms of last_agent_text_at only when its thread's streak >= the number of agent participants without left_at (the first round after a person's text is free of the gap), after every other rule passes.
Compare JSON values: optional fields are omitted when absent; object key order does not matter.
Commit = {head, message?, change}; change kinds: message, message-updated, read-cursor, conversation, invite.
The head guard counts a retracted agent message and applies the gap to the last agent text message however old. The cases named 'loop guard:' are the work-card bypass that a row window misses.

Cloud participants.add of an agent: only its owner (a stored record's owner_user wins over the op's), unless request.trusted_participant is true (the host's reach policy approved it and stamped owner_user and display_name).

Cloud invite.accept: request.actor_addresses holds the address ids of the actor's verified emails; the host passes it only when the email is verified. Group invites bind at once only for email with a matching address; otherwise status pending_approval.
The host derives token_hash: invite.create stores hash(hash(secret)), and the Domain hashes the accept proof hash(secret), so no event carries a value that can accept.
